description: This file defines the CandidateStatusAPI class providing an API endpoint for listing candidate statuses in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It extends the Endpoint class and implements CollectionEndpoint, with a focus on retrieving candidate status data with internationalization support.

classes.name: CandidateStatusAPI
classes.description: Provides API endpoints for accessing candidate status data in the recruitment module, mainly supporting listing all candidate statuses with internationalization.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all candidate statuses, mapping status IDs to their localized labels.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint, which are empty in this implementation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Method intended for creating a new candidate status, but currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for create operation, not implemented.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Method intended for deleting a candidate status, but currently not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for delete operation, not implemented.
